title: Data Collection Latency (Bar Time vs Collection Time)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__time(received_at) as time,
  CONCAT(vendor, ' - ', symbol) as vendor_symbol,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - timestamp))/60 as collection_delay_minutes
FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon 
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  $__time(received_at) as time,
  CONCAT(vendor, ' - ', symbol) as vendor_symbol,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - timestamp))/60 as collection_delay_minutes
FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
ORDER BY 1,2
